name: command-watchdog
description: PreToolUse hook that supervises every Bash command, stops idle, overlong or orphaned commands, tracks real targets for wait loops, and supervises rtk's rewrite decision.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code Bash watchdog; Codex hook support is unavailable.
interface.longDescription: This plugin's watchdog is a Claude Code PreToolUse hook. Codex plugins do not load this Claude-format hooks/hooks.json file, and this plugin currently provides no Codex runtime component.
